name: Titan Clans
worldbuilding: Ogre kingdoms, giant tribes, monstrous nomads, and beast clans. Their ordinary warriors are already exceptionally large and powerful, while their armies rely on physical mass and devastating Charges.

factionRule.name: Massive Momentum
factionRule.effect: Faction-specific Titan Clans Units gain Impact 2 on successful Charges; generic Units recruited into Titan Clans instead gain Impact 1. Explicitly distinct printed Impact bonuses (such as Stampede) add to the faction bonus, but duplicate faction bonuses never stack. Charge distance is unchanged.

factionCommands.name: Thunderous Advance
factionCommands.effect: When the active Unit declares an eligible Charge target within the normal 12" declaration limit, it may Move up to 3" toward that target, ending legally and unengaged, then must attempt the declared Charge. This additional Assault-phase Move is not a Disengage or a normal Charge and does not extend the declaration limit.

factionCommands.name: Smash Through
factionCommands.effect: When the active Unit declares a Charge, its Charge Impact ignores the defending Unit’s Tough X during Armor Saves against that Impact only. Brace and ordinary Armor/Ward still apply; this does not improve the Unit's later melee Attack.

factionCommands.name: Roar of Dominance
factionCommands.effect: During the active Monster Unit's Assault activation, enemy Units cannot use Reaction Commands in response to that Monster's actions or Attacks until the end of this Assault activation. This does not stop a Reaction triggered by some other Unit's action.

factionCommands.name: Smash the Ranks
factionCommands.effect: For the active Unit's next eligible Attack this Phase, choose one of these battlefield-role counters: Anti-Infantry 4 or Anti-Ranged 4. The active Unit gains the selected Anti-tag 4 for its next eligible Attack against a Unit actually bearing the matching tag this Round. Applicable Anti ranks never add; use the highest. This is one CP-powered Command and cannot stack with another friendly Command on the same Attack.

abilities.name: Massive Charge
abilities.effect: Roll 3d6 for this unit's charges and keep the two highest.

abilities.name: Anti-Armored 4 Training
abilities.effect: This Unit gains Anti-Armored 4 on its eligible Weapon and Spell Attacks; add the bonus once to the combined Attack pool, not per Model.

abilities.name: Stampede
abilities.effect: Gain Impact +2 on a successful Charge.

abilities.name: Anti-Infantry 3 Training
abilities.effect: This Unit gains Anti-Infantry 3 on its eligible Weapon and Spell Attacks; add the bonus once to the combined Attack pool, not per Model.

abilities.name: Covering Barrage
abilities.effect: While this Unit remains stationary, friendly Monster Units within Medium gain Accurate 1 on their next Charge-phase Attack.

abilities.name: Boulderfall
abilities.effect: When this Unit declares a Boulder Toss Attack while stationary, spend 1 CP. That Attack gains Blast 1" until it resolves. This Command does not permit an additional Attack or override Heavy.

abilities.name: Stampede
abilities.effect: Gain Impact +2 on a successful Charge.

abilities.name: Throw Aside
abilities.effect: After inflicting an unsaved Hit to an engaged unit or after a successful Charge, reposition one enemy basic Model up to 2" to a legal position, maintaining Unit coherency.

abilities.name: Anti-Elite 2 Training
abilities.effect: This Unit gains Anti-Elite 2 on its eligible Weapon and Spell Attacks; add the bonus once to the combined Attack pool, not per Model.

abilities.name: Earthshatter
abilities.effect: On 3+, inflict Direct Damage 1 and Slow 1 on one visible enemy within Short.

abilities.name: Crack the Whip
abilities.effect: When a friendly Monster or Beast Unit within Short rolls its Charge Pool, reroll up to two dice, respecting the usual reroll restriction.

optionalUpgrades.name: Specialized Guidance
optionalUpgrades.effect: At list construction choose one existing creature/material Trait tag. Other friendly Units wholly within 3" gain Anti-[that tag] 2. Highest applicable Anti rank only. This is a passive aura, not a free Command; does not benefit its source.

abilities.name: Huge
abilities.effect: Counts as three Units for objective control.

abilities.name: Anti-Armored 3 Training
abilities.effect: This Unit gains Anti-Armored 3 on its eligible Weapon and Spell Attacks; add the bonus once to the combined Attack pool, not per Model.

abilities.name: Mobile Fortress
abilities.effect: Friendly units immediately behind the Mammoth benefit from Cover where appropriate.

factionLeader.name: Overtyrant

abilities.name: Supreme Bully
abilities.effect: The Overtyrant's Melee Attacks gain Anti-Monster 2 and Anti-Unique 2.

abilities.name: The Crushing Tide
abilities.effect: Up to two friendly Ogre or Monster Units within Medium gain +1 Impact and +1 Damage on their next Melee Attack this Round.

knownIssues: No printed Impact value, unusual for a melee-focused faction's Leader (every other Titan Clans signature melee Unit prints an Impact bonus or Massive Charge). Likely a drafting gap rather than intentional, since the Overtyrant otherwise has the faction's heaviest melee kit; not resolved here.

genericUnitsWorthTaking: Cheap auxiliaries, conventional Ranged Infantry, light mobile troops, Scouts, and ordinary Support Units. Ogre Warriors and Beast Riders are devastating but too expensive to efficiently cover every objective.
designNotes: v4.2 balance pass: added Stone Hurlers as the faction's Extra Core, a stationary ranged-support Monster unit reinforcing the Heavy Support doctrine rather than patching a weakness. Damage-1 weapons across the faction gained +1 Attack; Damage-2+ weapons kept their Attacks and gained a thematic Anti-[Type] (Anti-Armored on Ogre Warriors' Heavy Clubs and the Giant's Massive Club, Anti-Infantry on Beast Riders' Mauling Harness, Anti-Elite on the Tyrant's Great Weapon) or an improved Hit (War Mammoth's Crushing Tusks 4+ -> 3+). The Overtyrant's Supreme Bully passive also had its Anti-Monster/Anti-Unique values doubled from 1 to 2.
